About the Walker

Welcome to the Walker Art Center, a multidisciplinary arts institution located in the heart of Minneapolis.

Where out-of-the-ordinary experiences create transformative connections

A first date strolls in the shade of a giant blue rooster in the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden. A class discovers infinity in mirrored artworks. A teenager decides on drama school in the glow of a live performance.

Come for a day in the galleries or an evening in the cinema—wherever the Walker takes you, you’ll find yourself surrounded by art that speaks to you.

Dissolving boundaries between art and audience, garden and gallery, museum and metropolis

Located in the heart of Minneapolis, the Walker presents, collects, and supports the creation of groundbreaking work across the visual and performing arts, moving image, and design.

We engage communities through a dynamic array of exhibitions, performances, screenings, events, and initiatives. Our multi-acre campus includes 65,000 sq. ft. of exhibition space, the state-of-the-art McGuire Theater and the Walker Cinema. Just across the street, you’ll find the art-filled Minneapolis Sculpture Garden—free and open daily year-round, 6 am–12 midnight.

Visual Arts curates shows and experiences that explore the big ideas of our time.

Read more

Performing Arts presents boundary-pushing works of theater, dance, and music.

Read more

Moving Image explores the outer reaches of film as a medium in our Cinema and Mediatheque.

Read more

Design keeps the Walker at the forefront of aesthetics through exhibitions, events, and initiatives.

The Walker’s Public Engagement, Learning & Impact team brings communities together for experiences with contemporary art, artists, and ideas. Our programs spark curiosity and creativity, dialogue and delight.

Walker Art Center Staff
